Change ONLY the actual legs and tiny natural cloth response to this gait phase: LEFT late single support / RIGHT foot beginning forward reach: NEAR anatomical LEFT leg slopes back screen-right, boot is PLANTED FLAT and carries weight, heel not yet raised. FAR anatomical RIGHT leg slopes forward screen-left BEHIND it, boot is LOW IN THE AIR with toe and heel both clear of ground. Far right knee slightly bent. The far right boot has just passed forward of the near left boot, use a shorter stride than Image1. Preserve near-over-far thigh overlap.

No whole-character translation, mirroring, image deformation, running, jumping, high knees, extra limbs or crossed ankles. Keep calm short stride and at least one support foot. Entire hair, spear tip/butt and feet inside margins. Actual transparent alpha, no background/floor/shadow/checkerboard/text. Highest visual finish.
